candidates.description: The login route constructs a raw SQL query by directly interpolating req.body.email into the query string without parameterization or escaping, allowing SQL injection through the email field.
candidates.rationale: Line 34 uses a template literal to build a SQL query with `${req.body.email || ''}` directly embedded. Sequelize's raw query method does not parameterize string-interpolated values. An attacker can inject SQL via the email POST body to bypass authentication or extract data. Verification: send a crafted email value like `' OR 1=1 --` and observe if the query returns a user row.
candidates.title: SQL injection via unparameterized email interpolation in login query
